description: No clean concept found. Weakly: fires when the opponent holds cells (2,4)/(3,3)/(2,5) and I hold the bottom of column 2, and almost never when I hold (3,3) or (2,4) or the opponent holds (0,2) or (3,4). Strongest case: opponent stones at (0,4),(1,4),(1,5) over my (0,5) with my stones at (0,2),(0,3). In 3-stone openings it fires when the opponent has the corner (0,0) uncovered. Shifted or mirrored shapes do not fire.
effect: Mostly none measurable (<0.05 probability). In its strongest position (4,2,4,5,5,3,6) it suppresses column 3 by about 35 points in favour of columns 0-1.
notes: Hypotheses: empty-well column (F1 0.045, rejected); cell template (0.149); veto-cell template (best F1 0.169, AUROC 0.68, sim share 0.03). Activation is highly position-specific, not translation or mirror invariant, and cell effects flip sign with context (O vs X at (2,4)). Fires at all plies. Likely a mixture or a random direction. Synthesis reached 10.54 vs dev max 11.47.
